title: Every normalized section algebra has an affine presentation
statement: Let $S,F,T,f,L$ be as in [def-trf-section-proj-model], and let $A$ be any normalized section algebra [lem-trf-space-section-algebra-etale-base-change] for $(f,L)$. There exists a section-Proj model $M$ [def-trf-section-proj-model] whose section-algebra object is exactly $A$. No generation condition, cover or canonical map into Proj is assumed or asserted.

source.place: Tag 01LH, quasi-coherent graded algebra on affine opens; spaces-descent.tex Tag 0D3C, A and psi_d.

proof.text: Use the specified colimit of homogeneous inclusions to form RelativeProjAlgebra with the same actual section algebra, degrees, products and unit. The unique colimit comparison gives its decomposition and the inclusion equations.

On each affine open, the homogeneous inclusions are injective and sections commute with the quasi-coherent direct sum. Identify each homogeneous section module with its image in the total section ring. The affineData construction gives the graded algebra restrictions and graded base change.

Define each evaluation component by A.image composed with the inverse homogeneous identification. Additivity, semilinearity and base-open naturality follow from the tensor-section unit and module morphisms. Products, units and test naturality are the corresponding fields of A. The inverse laws give evaluation_eq.
